test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Aman, Raman and Yash together can complete a piece of work in 29 days. Raman and Yash together can complete the same work in 58 days. Aman, Raman and Yash started working together but Aman left the work after 15 days from starting. Find the number of days in which Raman and Yash completed the remaining work.
solution:
**Given:**

Aman, Raman and Yash together can complete the work in 29 days.

Aman takes 59 days to complete the work.

Raman takes 95 days to complete the work.

**Concept:**

Work done = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM(29, 58) = 58 units

Efficiency of Aman, Raman, and Yash together = 58/29 = 2

Efficiency of Raman and Yash together = 58/58 = 1

Work completed by Aman, Raman and Yash in starting 15 days = 15 × 2 = 30 units

Remaining work = 58 - 30 = 28 units

Days taken by Raman and Yash to complete 28 units of work = 28/1 = 28 days

**Therefore, Raman and Yash will take 28 days t
o complete the remaining work.**
